name: ev8-ops
description: EV8 Ops — operational system of E-Motion Motors LLC: fleet, rentals, payments, sales, service, WhatsApp

scripts.typecheck: npm -w @ev8/shared run typecheck && npm -w @ev8/api run typecheck && npm -w @ev8/worker run typecheck && npm -w @ev8/web run typecheck
scripts.guard: npm run guard:i18n && npm run guard:tokens && npm run guard:code && npm run guard:errors && npm run guard:actions && npm run guard:hooks
